corrections.reason: 中文用“令人惊叹”表达赞叹，避免“惊人的龙的画”歧义。

corrected_body.en: The view from the mountain was truly amazing.
corrected_body.zh: 山顶的景色十分令人惊叹。

corrected_body.en: She showed us an amazing drawing of a dragon.
corrected_body.zh: 她给我们看了一幅令人惊叹的龙的画。

corrections.reason: 把“我一直醒着”改为日常自然的表达。

corrected_body.en: I stayed awake until my father came home.
corrected_body.zh: 我一直没睡，直到爸爸回家。

corrected_body.en: The loud noise kept everyone awake last night.
corrected_body.zh: 昨晚的巨响让大家无法入睡。

corrections.reason: 原文只说 cooked with，不能在译文中自行指定“炖”的烹调方式。

corrected_body.en: Dad cooked beef with carrots for our dinner.
corrected_body.zh: 爸爸把牛肉和胡萝卜一起烹调，作为我们的晚餐。

corrected_body.en: Would you like some beef in your noodles?
corrected_body.zh: 你想在面条里加点牛肉吗？

corrections.reason: 修正“勇敢到敢于尝试”的重复生硬中文。
一盒独立巧克力糖采用常用复数搭配 a box of chocolates。

corrected_body.en: My sister made hot chocolate on a cold evening.
corrected_body.zh: 一个寒冷的晚上，姐姐做了热巧克力。

corrected_body.en: I gave Grandma a small box of chocolates.
corrected_body.zh: 我送给奶奶一小盒巧克力。
